name: Akiba de Ocha Shiyo!
source:
Main character's father leaves him after death a coffee shop, debt and four young bride candidates. Together with the girls they need to work at the coffee shop to repay the debt.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
父亲去世后，留给主人公一家咖啡厅、一笔债务，以及四名年轻的新娘候选人。他必须和四名少女一起经营咖啡厅，偿还债务。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
